transcript:
I need you to get this egg and put it on the claw arm coming out of the car. What's so difficult about this simple task?
Don't forget to find those tapes. You know, there's a bunch of tapes hidden all over the place. They spared no expense.
What are you doing here? You stay away from my Morty.
If Morty can make his way to high school, I'm pretty sure you can figure out how to put your hands on some stupid pads.
Clone Morty, step back. I'm gonna suit you up for combat. I'm not dealing with these dumb insects today.
source: Justin Roiland · Rick and Morty: Virtual Rick-ality · compressed dialogue mirror
